OverlaySafety.ModeHint.zh: 自动优先使用增强，检测或初始化失败时回退普通。增强和普通固定使用所选模式，不做自动检测或回退；强制增强也关闭输入超时保护。保存后重启生效。
OverlaySafety.ModeHint.en: Automatic prefers enhancement and falls back when detection or initialization fails. Enhanced and Ordinary force the selected backend without automatic checks or fallback; forced enhancement also disables input timeout protection. Restart after saving to apply.

OverlaySafety.ModeSaved.zh: 已保存覆盖模式，重启浮绘后生效。
OverlaySafety.ModeSaved.en: Overlay mode saved. Restart FloatCanvas to apply.

OverlaySafety.ForcedFailure.zh: 强制增强模式初始化失败，未自动切换为普通模式。可使用 --desktop-mode 启动，再到设置中更改模式。
OverlaySafety.ForcedFailure.en: Forced enhancement could not initialize. No fallback was performed. Start with --desktop-mode to change the mode in Settings.

OverlaySafety.DesktopNotice.zh: 本次未能启用全屏增强，已使用普通桌面模式。绘画和文件功能仍可使用；下次启动会重新检查。
OverlaySafety.DesktopNotice.en: Fullscreen enhancement could not be enabled for this session. Desktop drawing and file operations remain available; the next launch will check again.

OverlaySafety.RecoverFailed.zh: 无法完成自动回退。请保存画布后退出，并使用 --desktop-mode 重新启动浮绘。
OverlaySafety.RecoverFailed.en: Automatic fallback could not finish. Save your canvas, exit, and restart FloatCanvas with --desktop-mode.
